title: The daily-loss breaker and the exposure cap compare numbers in different units: buy rows store the ETH/BNB amount as a decimal ("0.01") while sell rows store the proceeds and gas as wei integers, so ordinary losing trades never count as a loss and one partial sell makes total exposure hugely negative

evidence.note: snipe V2 buy row: amountIn = ctx.chain.snipeAmount, a decimal string in native units ("0.01"); gasCost null
snipe V3 buy row: same (amountIn = ctx.chain.snipeAmount)
deliberate buy row: amountIn = ethers.formatEther(amountInWei), also a native-unit decimal
sell row: amountOut and gasCost straight from the receipt decoder
amountOut = WETH Withdrawal wad.toString(): wei integer string (V3 at :99 the same)
getDailyRealizedLoss: CAST(s.amount_out AS REAL) - CAST(b.amount_in AS REAL) - CAST(b.gas_cost) - CAST(s.gas_cost), summed only where < 0: wei minus a decimal ETH amount
getTotalExposure: CAST(b.amount_in AS REAL) - SUM(partial_sell amount_out): decimal ETH minus wei
canSnipe compares those sums to -(maxCapital * DAILY_LOSS_PCT / 100) (native units) and to MAX_TOTAL_EXPOSURE (native units)

evidence.ref: node risk-sql-repro.js <snapshot>/src/utils/db.ts (scratch folder outside the repo (Node 22.16.0; no src/ import, no .env, no live DB; loopback 127.0.0.1 only); in-memory ':memory:' SQLite through the repo better-sqlite3; the SQL text of getDailyRealizedLoss, getTotalExposure and getPnLQuery is extracted verbatim from the audit-base snapshot; rows written in the formats above)
evidence.note: output: 25 trades each sold at a 50% loss (true loss 0.1325 ETH against a 0.1 ETH limit) -> SQL daily loss = 0, breaker does not trip; one 99.99% loss -> -2.99e14 (trips); one profitable sell whose amount_out could not be decoded (NULL) -> -3e14 (trips for 24 h); 10 open 0.01 buys -> exposure 0.1, then one 0.006 ETH partial sell -> exposure -6e15 and the cap check (e + 0.01 > 10.0) is false forever; getPnL realized_pnl of that position = 5.7e15
sibling (API slice): the dashboard divides the live price by 1e18 but adds sell_revenue (wei) to buy_cost (decimal ETH) unconverted

sibling_sites_checked: Every insertTrade.run site at the base SHA (git grep -n -A16 "insertTrade.run"): bot.ts:773 (deliberate), :1127 (V2 snipe), :1451 (V3 snipe) write decimal native amount_in and null gas; exitEngine.ts:1073 (sell) and :1550 (partial sell) write wei amount_out and wei gas_cost. Every SQL that mixes them: db.ts getPnLQuery (:351-384), getTotalExposure (:425-438), getDailyRealizedLoss (:441-459), getPnLChartDataQuery (:463-485) and riskManager.ts exposureByChain (:48-63). Consumers: riskManager canSnipe (enforcement), api/routes/risk.ts:66 and :80-95, api/routes/trades.ts:85-180, api/routes/health.ts:66 and api/helpers/positions.ts:144-168 (display, API slice). No conversion (formatEther or / 1e18) of amount_out or gas_cost exists anywhere at the base SHA (git grep "amount_out\|sell_revenue\|realized_pnl").
severity_rationale: S1 EXPOSURE: a configured risk limit is bypassed under the most ordinary condition there is (a sniped token that loses 10-90%). The daily-loss breaker (RISK-02) only ever trips on a sell that returned less than its own gas (near-total loss) or whose proceeds were not decoded, and then for a whole day; normal losing streaks are invisible to it. With partial sells configured (PARTIAL_SELL_TARGETS, empty by default) the exposure cap (RISK-05) is disabled for as long as that position stays open. Not S0: the per-trade size, the position count and the cooldown still bound spending, and the bot is OFF. Proven on the real SQL text with an offline in-memory database, not on mocks. Context for the operator: the OD-25 defaults (MAX_TOTAL_EXPOSURE, DAILY_LOSS_PCT) cannot work as written until this is fixed, so tuning them first would not change what the bot does.
recommendation: Store every amount in one unit (wei integer strings, as the receipts already are) and compare in bigint, or convert at the SQL boundary in one place; backfill existing buy rows with a migration. Add a real-path test that writes rows through the real insert sites and asserts the breaker trips. How the risk limits should count (units, failed-held positions, partial sells, per-chain cap) is card DB-01. Phase 24; nothing is changed in Phase 22.

sub_claims.claim: Buy rows store amount_in as a native decimal string; sell and partial-sell rows store amount_out and gas_cost as wei integer strings
The daily-loss breaker does not count ordinary losing trades and trips for a day on a decoder miss or a near-total loss
evidence: node risk-sql-repro.js (offline in-memory reproduction, output in evidence)

sub_claims.claim: One partial sell makes total exposure negative by about the proceeds in wei, so the exposure cap never refuses while that position is open
Dashboard P&L, risk utilisation and trade filters show mixed-unit numbers (realized_pnl about 5.7e15 for a small profit)
